searchText: we're aiming for the earliest timeline possible, but security and testing come first. more likely Q1 2022 anyone know the best solution for sending ERC-20 tokens to many many thousands of wallets every week for no fees how would a transaction without fees work exactly? if you want to save money, let them withdraw from a contract to leverage gas fee onto your users i should do that, is there an easy way to create a button that opens a MetaMask request to my address with the pre-filled amount that can't be changed? There is no way to recover the lost ETH short of tracking down the scammer and "convincing" them to give it back. <@301186049323958275> thank you for your fast response. I did check the Waller on etherscan.io, but since I’m kinda new to all that, I don’t really know what to look for I strongly recommend you just write it off as a loss/learning experience. The chances of recovering your funds are effectively 0. The scammer very likely lives in a different country than you, and any operation to recover the funds would involve multiple government agencies from multiple countries and the chance that any of the recovered money (in the case of a successful recovery) make it back to the victims is near 0, even if they could track down the scammer and recover the funds. Ok, well thank you for your explanations. A hard learning experience (about 1.8 Eth, a lot of money for me), but may it so Deleted the original message. Please please please never post links to suspected scams. You only confuse people, get accidental clicks, and cause more damage for others.
